## Description

Brief summary of changes made and motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Security fix / hardening
- [ ] Refactor / code cleanup
- [ ] Documentation update

## Areas Affected

- [ ] Backend API (`backend/app/...`)
- [ ] Frontend UI (`frontend/src/...`)
- [ ] Security & Authorization (`auth/`, `dependencies.py`, JWT, session tokens)
- [ ] Database & Schemas (`MongoDB`, Pydantic models)
- [ ] CI/CD & Infrastructure (`.github/workflows/`, Docker, scripts)

## Verification & Testing

- [ ] Backend test suite passes (`python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`)
- [ ] Frontend unit tests pass (`cd frontend && npm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript check clean (`cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] ESLint clean (`cd frontend && npm run lint`)
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`cd frontend && npm run build`)
